messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "potassium level via blood test within a week of starting or changing dose"
set: ["potassium level via blood test within a week of starting or changing dose", "one week of starting or changing dose", "potassium level", "risk of high potassium level", "increased potassium level", "high potassium level", "increased potassium level regardless of use", "dangerously high potassium level", "2% of mother's blood level", "dose is adjusted at intervals of a week or longer", "mouth-related effects begin within minutes of a dose", "substantial presence within 1 week", "blood potassium levels", "potassium level regularly after initial check", "high blood potassium", "lowers blood potassium"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
